name: Heliocast Reinforcement
description:
The §5§lHeliocast Reinforcement§r (HR) module is the final §nExo-Foundry§r module unlocked in §9§lUIV§r. 

The HR module finally allows you access to §9§lUIV+§r Fluid Solidifier recipes. Now you can cool higher tier materials or create advanced reinforced glass types using the Foundry.

The HR module is also unique in being able to pair with itself, at a cost. Installing three or more §5HR§r modules on your Foundry will unlock "§6Entropic Core§r" and produce these effects:

- Processing values are randomly increased by a factor of §6Entropy§r, which is rolled independently for each value.
- §6Entropy§r is a value from 0 to the number of HR modules present (inclusive) and is rolled at the start of every recipe.
- §6Entropy§r can either severely slow down processing or speed it up, making this pairing random.
- The average §6Entropy§r values are S=1.5 with 3 HR modules and S=2.0 with 4 HR modules.

At 3 HR, processing values are as follows:

+§6(S*8)§r Parallels per Voltage tier
+§a(S*100%)§r Speed
-§b(S*15%)§r Total EU/t
+§d(S*0.05)§r OC Factor

At 4 HR:

+§dS§r Overclocks

[note]Never gonna know what yer gonna get![/note]
